items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: He was the first one to take, he took me on my first big job.

ctx.x: started playing. So they started playing. So a lot of families that had pianos, I mean people played blues. Was there a lot of blues played in the saloons?

Yeah. That's all they would play in the saloons, was blues. Were they just solo pianists? Yeah. Most of the piano players who were really popular, they played piano and sang too. They would sing and play the piano. And there's a guy who, did you ever hear of Trits Washington? Sure. Yeah. He was the first one to take, he took me on my first big job. So what took you on your first big job? Yeah, at the Cotton Club. Yeah, just built a new place, they had rebuilt a place on Rampart Street where he had gambling and…
that was the top place. The rhythm club was the top place?
